Pathways.org is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization that has been providing FREE child development information to empower parents and health professionals since 1985. https://pathways.org/ 

First, check out our milestone videos to make sure your child is on track with their development. Then, watch our Parents' Guide video series and videos on Tummy Time, motor skills, sensory integration, and more for tips to help encourage your child's development.
